characteristics.name: Strength
characteristics.description: Represents physical prowess used for climbing, lifting, pushing, and melee damage.
characteristics.low_effect: Struggles to lift, push, and oppose Strength Tests; unopposed Strength Tests take twice as long; gains Fatigue on failed opposed Strength Tests.
characteristics.zero_effect: Cannot lift, carry, push, or deal melee damage; cannot brace weapons; drops weapons after attacking.
characteristics.citation: “Strength is the physical prowess your Character possesses.”

characteristics.name: Toughness
characteristics.description: Represents resistance to damage and debilitating effects; determines Wounds.
characteristics.low_effect: Staggers when making Toughness Tests against negative effects, losing next Half Action.
characteristics.zero_effect: Character enters a coma until Toughness is restored.
characteristics.citation: “Toughness is the Character's resistance to Damage and debilitating effects.”

characteristics.name: Agility
characteristics.description: Represents speed, reflexes, movement, and evasion.
characteristics.low_effect: Must pass +15 Agility Test to Run or Sprint or fall Prone; cannot use Agility for Stunt.
characteristics.citation: “Agility measures the character's speed and reflexes.”

characteristics.name: Warfare Range
characteristics.description: Represents ability to use ranged weapons effectively.
characteristics.low_effect: Cannot make Called Shots or Aim Actions with ranged weapons.
characteristics.zero_effect: Cannot attack unless target is Helpless and Point Blank.
characteristics.citation: “Warfare Range is the measurement of the character's ability to use ranged-based weaponry.”

characteristics.name: Warfare Melee
characteristics.description: Represents ability to use melee weapons and hand-to-hand combat.
characteristics.low_effect: Cannot make Called Shots or Aim Actions with melee weapons.
characteristics.zero_effect: Cannot attack unless target is Helpless and Point Blank.
characteristics.citation: “Warfare Melee is the character's ability to use melee-based weaponry.”

characteristics.name: Intellect
characteristics.low_effect: Takes twice as long to solve problems even on successful Tests.
characteristics.zero_effect: Cannot make Actions; must be led; cannot respond or perform basic tasks.
characteristics.citation: “Intellect is the amount at which characters know and the wisdom the character owns.”

characteristics.name: Perception
characteristics.description: Represents sensory awareness and determines Perceptive Range.
characteristics.low_effect: Cannot judge direction or distance of sounds; struggles to see beyond Perceptive Range.
characteristics.zero_effect: Cannot understand surroundings; suffers -40 to Attacks before other penalties.
characteristics.citation: “Perception describes the ability to survey their surroundings.”

characteristics.name: Courage
characteristics.description: Represents ability to withstand fear and maintain composure.
characteristics.low_effect: Flees for first Half Action when scared.
characteristics.zero_effect: Always panics; always last in Initiative; loses all Opposed Tests in melee.
characteristics.citation: “Courage reflects the character's ability to withstand horrors and fears.”

characteristics.name: Charisma
characteristics.description: Represents social ability and understanding of cues.
characteristics.low_effect: Takes double time to speak or respond; struggles to understand speech.
characteristics.zero_effect: Cannot speak; struggles to understand speech.
characteristics.citation: “Charisma is the character's ability to interact with other characters.”

characteristics.name: Leadership
characteristics.description: Represents ability to give and understand orders.
characteristics.low_effect: Takes twice as long to give orders; takes a Full Action to understand orders.
characteristics.citation: “Leadership is the character's ability to lead forces and to take orders.”
